mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nsist_org_mapping ( org_cd, user_id, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm ) VALUES ( #{orgCd}, #{userId}, #{initRegiPic}, #{initRegiDttm}, #{finalRvisPic}, #{finalRvisDttm} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, org_cd, user_id, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM nsist_org_mapping WHERE org_cd = #{orgCd}
SELECT m.id, m.org_cd, m.user_id, u.login_id, u.name, m.init_regi_dttm, m.final_rvis_dttm FROM nsist_org_mapping m JOIN "user" u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.org_cd = #{orgCd}
SELECT m.id, m.org_cd, m.user_id, u.login_id, u.name, m.init_regi_dttm, m.final_rvis_dttm FROM nsist_org_mapping m JOIN "user" u ON u.id = m.user_id ORDER BY m.id ASC
